transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?
I came in because I feel wound up almost all the time. It’s like my body is bracing for the next bad thing, even when I’m just sitting at my desk or trying to enjoy dance night.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about different things in your life, like work, relationships, or health, even when there isn’t a clear reason to worry?

Yes. It kind of jumps around. It used to be mostly about my condo, but now I’ll worry my cousin is upset with me, then I’m worried I’ll mess up on a support call at work, and then I’m thinking about money and whether I’m ever going to move forward in life. Even when nothing specific has happened, my mind just keeps going there.
Do you notice any physical symptoms like muscle tension, trouble sleeping, or restlessness along with these worries?

Yes, definitely. I feel wound up a lot of the time, like my body is tense or on alert even when nothing is happening. I can be sitting at my desk or out at dance night, and I still feel like I’m bracing for something bad.
Are these feelings of tension and worry usually tied to specific situations or things, or do they seem to come up even when you’re not in any particular stressful situation?

It comes up even when there isn’t a specific stressful thing happening. Like, I can just be sitting at my desk or trying to enjoy dance night, and I still feel wound up, like I’m bracing for something bad to happen.
